Question text is a sibling label above the control; required marker is the '✱' glyph (U+2731) in the label, plus the required attribute.

control_families.eeo: select name=eeo[gender|race|veteran] (lv-02, rendered hidden in DOM snapshot; options 'Select ...', Male/Female/Decline…; race list of 8 + decline; veteran 'I am a veteran'/'I am not a veteran'/'Decline to self-identify').

runtime_observations: Required marker is the '✱' glyph (U+2731), not '*'; the required attribute is also set on inputs.
Custom question labels are not <label for>; they sit above the control, so label association must use proximity within the card container.
EEO selects can be display:none in the DOM until scrolled/expanded; treat visible=false as 'present but not yet interactable', not absent.
Radio/checkbox groups share a name; option labels are separate <label> elements; the question is the nearest non-option text above the group.

inferred.resume_accept_inference: Lever accepts pdf/doc/docx/txt/rtf per its public docs; accept attr absent so cannot be read from DOM.

provider_hint.for_jev: Lever single-page /apply form. Bind by visible label; required = '✱' or required attr. Custom cards mix text/select/radio/checkbox/textarea; some employers couple salary amount + pay period + currency. Attestation checkboxes and tool-consent radios need explicit user authorisation. Stop at 'SUBMIT APPLICATION'.
escalate_to_writer_opus: referral text if user names a referrer
requires_human_input: salary expectation if no verified fact

edge_cases: A country select can appear without a name attribute (lv-01 'What is your location?'), so name-based binding fails; use label.
Same employer posts (Wpromote ×5 in inventory) likely share one custom card set; do not assume across employers.
